# Sample project

An internal tool that syncs pricing tables between two systems.

## Layout

```
.claude/
├── skills/
│   └── demo/
│       └── SKILL.md
├── documentation/
│   └── guides/
│       └── deploy.md
└── settings.json
```

## Build

- `make build` — builds the sync binary
- `make test` — runs the contract tests
